name: Live notes panel
oneLiner: a glass notes window swings in beside the speaker: title bar, a toolbar, a heading bar in the brand colour slams in, then the notes type themselves line by line under a caret with A, B, C markers, and a highlighter swipes the line that matters
say: when the speaker breaks an idea into points as they talk ('why we buy the hype: A, lots of people are talking about it; B, people we trust are'): cut in on the topic, set duration to the length of the explanation so each line types as it's said; on 16:9 the editor places the speaker on the other half (side picks the panel's half)
